note: Hand-labeled key provisions of NCCI Chapter 1, Section D (E&M Services). A provision counts as 'captured' if some extracted rule's text contains all of its match `terms`.

gold.concept: An E&M on the same day as a major (090-day) surgery, to decide whether to operate, is separately reportable with modifier 57.
Other preoperative E&M on the same day as a major surgery is included in the global payment and not separately reportable.
The decision to perform a minor surgical procedure is included in its payment and not separately reportable as an E&M.
A significant, separately identifiable E&M may be reported with modifier 25.
Postoperative E&M related to recovery is included in the global surgical package.
Postoperative visits unrelated to the surgery's diagnosis may be reported with modifier 24.
For XXX-global procedures, a significant separately identifiable E&M may be reported with modifier 25.
